channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Auxiliar de Flávio Bolsonaro para área econômica propõe cortes equivalentes a 1,5% do PIB
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro, proposed cutting government spending equivalent to 1.5% of GDP through measures such as securitizing active debt, creating a real estate fund with federal properties, revising state-owned enterprises, and expanding public-private partnerships. The plan also includes establishing a Superior Fiscal Governance Council and implementing a 'management shock'. Daniella is being considered as a potential running mate for Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Ronaldo Caiado na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Social Democratic Party (PSD) officially launched Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate on July 26, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate, during a national convention in São Paulo. Caiado thanked his family, political allies across Brazil — including Goiás Governor Daniel Vilela and figures like Ratinho and Eduardo Leite — emphasizing the ticket’s role in overcoming political polarization and implementing a new governance model for the nation.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Romeu Zema na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: Romeu Zema was officially nominated as the Novo Party's presidential candidate in a virtual convention held on July 27, 2026. In his speech, he emphasized his private sector background, his status as a net taxpayer, and criticized the PT administration in Minas Gerais for administrative collapse, unpaid wages, and criminal acts such as unlawful payroll deductions. Zema claimed he possesses all the credentials to lead Brazil, citing his experience with bureaucracy, job creation, and anti-corruption governance.

item.title: Ministros do STF voltam do recesso à espera de defesa enfática de Nunes Marques às urnas e de punição por uso de IA pelo PL
item.description: STF ministers expect TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to deliver a strong defense of electronic voting machines to counter Bolsonaro family doubts, and to sanction the PL and its candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for illegal AI-generated videos that favor the candidate and attack opponents, violating the tribunal’s resolution.

item.title: Flávio reduz distância para Lula e ambos seguem em empate técnico no segundo turno, aponta BTG/Nexus
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) narrowed the gap with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a potential runoff, according to a BTG/Nexus poll released Monday. Despite the gain, Bolsonaro remains numerically behind Lula, keeping the two in a technical tie.

item.title: Eleições brasileiras estão na mira da extrema direita global
item.description: Javier Milei's appearance at a Bolsonarist event, repeated verbal attacks by the Argentine president on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and growing criticism from Washington toward the Brazilian government signal a rising risk of foreign interference in Brazil's 2026 presidential election. These actions suggest a coordinated effort by the global far right to influence Brazil's political landscape.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento sobre alcance da Lei Maria da Penha
item.description: The STF will resume judging the scope of the Maria da Penha Law, assessing whether its protective measures apply to gender-based violence outside the domestic context. It will also rule on the constitutionality of restricting tax exemptions for people with disabilities or autism in car purchases under the 2025 tax reform. The ruling on the interim governorship election in Rio de Janeiro has been postponed to August 19.

item.title: PRTB oficializa Leonardo Avalanche como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The PRTB officially launched Leonardo Avalanche as its presidential candidate for 2026, following Pablo Marçal's ineligibility. Avalanche, a businessman and party president since 2024, proposes the 'iPhone for Every Brazilian' program tied to entrepreneurship courses. The candidacy is framed as a conservative, anti-system alternative, emphasizing tax reduction and clean, technical governance.

item.title: Governo nomeia assessores para gabinete de apoio ao presidente Lula
item.description: The federal government appointed Douglas Valletta Luz and Daniel Zagotta de Oliveira as special advisors in the Advisory Cabinet for Information in Support of Decision-Making, linked to the Personal Office of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, as published in the Official Gazette. The appointments were signed by Minister of the Civil House, Miriam Belchior, on July 31, 2026. This move is part of a broader set of personnel changes across multiple ministries, including adjustments in Institutional Relations, Racial Equality, Education, Health, Agrarian Development, and Labor.

item.title: Como está a disputa entre Jerônimo e ACM Neto pelo governo da Bahia, segundo o Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: ACM Neto (União Brasil) leads the Bahia gubernatorial race against Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) with 48.9% in the first round and 50.9% in the second round, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released on August 3, 2026. Jerônimo Rodrigues trails with 38.7% and 40.0% respectively, within a 2.7 pp margin of error. Jerônimo also has the highest rejection rate at 41%, compared to ACM Neto's 28.2%.

item.title: Lula tem 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro 45% em cenário de 2º turno, mostra pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on August 3 shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro technically tied at 46% and 45% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, within the two-point margin of error. Lula also maintains a technical lead over Ronaldo Caiado (46%-42%), Romeu Zema (46%-40%), and Renan Santos (47%-37%), with blank/null/undecided votes ranging from 2% to 13% across scenarios.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 48% e aprovado por 47%, diz Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released in August 2026 shows President Lula's government with 48% disapproval and 47% approval, with 43% rating it as 'bad' or 'terrible' and 37% as 'excellent' or 'good'. In the first round, Lula leads with 41% voting intention versus 37% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), while in a potential runoff they are technically tied at 46% to 45%. Both candidates have a 49% rejection rate.

item.title: Flávio e Lula são rejeitados por 49% dos eleitores, diz Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released in August 2026 shows that President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro share the same rejection rate at 49%. Lula leads with 41% of voting intentions in the first round, compared to 37% for Flávio, and holds a narrow lead in a potential runoff (46% to 45%), indicating a technical tie. The Lula government is disapproved by 48% and approved by 47%, with 43% rating the administration as bad or terrible.

item.title: Governo Lula é aprovado por 47% e desaprovado por 48%, diz BTG/Nexus
item.description: President Lula's government shows 47% approval and 48% disapproval, a technical tie within the margin of error, according to BTG/Nexus poll. Public perception remained stable compared to the previous survey, with 37% rating the administration as excellent or good and 43% as poor or terrible. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied in rejection at 49% each, while Lula leads the first round with 41% versus Bolsonaro's 37%.

item.title: Michelle agradece apoio de Flávio após crise de enxaqueca
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro thanked Flávio Bolsonaro, Bia Kicis, and Valdemar Costa Neto for their support after being hospitalized for refractory migraines, which prevented her from attending the PL convention that formalized her Senate candidacy for the Federal District. She underwent cranial nerve block procedures and was discharged on Sunday, highlighting the support from her family and fellow pre-candidates.

item.title: A piora na percepção da economia que faz Flávio Bolsonaro empatar com Lula em nova pesquisa
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) technically tied with Lula (PT) in a potential runoff, with 45% and 46% respectively, within the two-point margin of error. In the first round, Bolsonaro rose to 37% and Lula fell to 41%, also resulting in a technical tie. Economic perception worsened: 45% of voters now see the economy as worse under Lula compared to Bolsonaro (up from 42%), while only 39% see it as better (down from 40%).

item.title: Flávio encurta distância para Lula, indica Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on Monday shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) narrowed his deficit against Lula (PT) in the first round from nine to four points. In the simulated runoff scenario, Lula’s lead over Bolsonaro’s son also decreased, though the exact new margin was not specified in the original text. The data suggest a tightening race between the two candidates.

item.title: “Foi libertado por falha administrativa, não por ser inocente”, diz Milei sobre Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei reiterated his criticism of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, stating that Lula was released from prison due to an administrative error, not innocence. Milei labeled Lula a 'thief' and 'corrupt', emphasizing that he served time in prison, making it true that he is a former inmate.

item.title: Concursos públicos seguem previstos durante período eleitoral
item.description: In an election year, public sector competitive exams remain permitted under Brazilian law, with restrictions only applying to the appointment of approved candidates during the campaign period. Through the end of 2026, two exams have published notices (Dataprev and ABGF, with registrations open until August 6) and five have defined examination boards, including Petrobras and professional councils. Experts state that the election year should not deter candidates, given existing budget allocations and prepared administrative structures.

item.title: Os bastidores do fim do casamento de Eduardo Leite e Thalis Bolzan: sem festa, sem filhos
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite and physician Thalis Bolzan announced the end of their marriage in a joint statement, after a month of silent separation. The decision was mutual, attributed to the strain of differing routines and conflicting schedules, with no apparent scandal or third-party involvement. Thalis has already moved out of the Piratini Palace, and the couple will share custody of their four dogs.

item.title: A boa notícia para Flávio Bolsonaro em nova pesquisa a dois meses do primeiro turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) narrowed the gap with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the runoff, cutting the deficit from 4 points to just 1 point, according to BTG/Nexus poll. In the first round, Lula dropped to 41% and Bolsonaro rose to 37%, shrinking Lula’s lead from 9 to 4 points. With a 2-point margin of error, the runoff is now a technical tie, with Lula at 46% and Bolsonaro at 45%.

item.title: Milei dobra a aposta e volta a criticar Lula: 'é um ladrão, um corrupto'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei again attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him a 'thief' and 'corrupt', referencing his Lava Jato conviction that was annulled in 2021. Milei said his remarks were spontaneous and defended himself as telling the truth, accusing Lula of politically interfering in the region with socialist ideas. He also mentioned being barred from visiting Jair Bolsonaro in Brazil due to a decision by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha fez mais de 40 visitas fora da agenda a órgãos do governo Lula
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger made over 40 unregistered visits to federal government offices since 2023, being a close friend of Lulinha and under suspicion for influence trafficking. She was accompanied by Lulinha’s former business partner, Fernando Bittar, in two visits to the Planalto Palace and the Social Development Ministry, with no official records. The Federal Police opened investigations into both for allegedly using presidential influence to benefit private business interests, particularly in the Health Ministry and the Presidency.

item.title: Augusto Cury confirma candidatura e avalia rivais: ‘Lula e Flávio estão tomados pelo ego’
item.description: Augusto Cury, a 67-year-old writer and psychiatrist, confirmed his presidential candidacy for the Avante party, criticizing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro as being 'taken by ego' and arguing that Brazil needs a state project, not a party project. He claims neither can pacify the country, as they thrive on polarization and digital radicalism, and says he entered politics to pursue a more serious Brazil, not for visibility or career advancement.

item.title: 'Lula vive um efeito Biden', diz cientista política americana sobre desânimo do eleitorado brasileiro
item.description: American political scientist Wendy Hunter compares the diffuse voter disillusionment surrounding Lula in Brazil to the sentiment that surrounded Joe Biden in his final months in office, describing a widespread sense of political fatigue and disillusionment. She notes that despite Lula’s electoral victory, his government faces similar challenges to Biden’s, including low public confidence and a perception of stagnation.

item.title: Ministério investiga uso de emenda de líder do União por promoção
item.description: The Ministry of Sports will open an internal investigation into the use of a parliamentary amendment by União Brasil leader Pedro Lucas Fernandes (MA) to fund the Bacanga Olympics, an event whose promotional materials featured his name and that of Ivan Júnior, suggesting possible personal promotion using public funds. The R$980,000 was transferred to an NGO linked to Ivan Júnior’s family and executed by a company tied to his former aides. If irregularities are confirmed, the Ministry will take administrative measures and refer the case to the Electoral Public Prosecutor’s Office if electoral law violations are suspected.

item.title: Marqueteiro tenta montar equipe antes dar “sim” definitivo a Flávio
item.description: Political marketer Duda Lima was invited to lead the communications strategy for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign (PL) but has not yet given a definitive 'yes,' conditioning his acceptance on assembling a specialized team. According to PL sources, he is struggling to recruit professionals, as many are already committed to other campaigns. Lima emphasizes that a presidential race requires a robust and highly specialized structure.

item.title: Para especialistas, governadores influenciam pouco na disputa nacional
item.description: Political scientists state that gubernatorial elections have almost no influence on presidential races, as voters differentiate their choices for president and governor. In polarized scenarios, federal government evaluation, the economy, and ideological identification weigh more in presidential decisions, while gubernatorial elections are driven by local issues and assessments of state administrations. Recent history confirms this: Lula won in 2022 despite adversarial governors winning in key states like São Paulo and Minas Gerais.

item.title: Michelle não precisa de Flávio, mas Flávio depende de Michelle
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro was hospitalized for a migraine, avoiding an awkward encounter with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro at the PL convention. Despite their strained relationship, she accepted his virtual apologies and pledged support, though did not appear in person. Flávio relies on his father’s electoral legacy to remain competitive, while Michelle has a strong independent base in the Federal District and does not need him to win a Senate seat.

item.title: Alckmin vira peça estratégica na tentativa de reeleição de Lula
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) has been officially nominated as Lula’s running mate for the 2026 re-election bid, appointed as campaign coordinator for the Southeast and seen as a strategic asset to strengthen the presidential slates in São Paulo and Minas Gerais. His background in São Paulo’s interior and four-term governorship position him to overcome PT’s regional resistance, while he also engages agribusiness and leads international negotiations, such as the U.S. tariff response.

item.title: STF volta do recesso com expectativa sobre eleições no RJ e Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumed its activities after the recess, with an initial agenda focused on tax exemptions for people with disabilities and the application of the Maria da Penha Law. The main expectation centers on the judgment of the supplementary elections for governor of Rio de Janeiro, scheduled for August 19, which will determine whether the election will be direct or indirect. Additionally, a pending ruling on the constitutionality of changes to the Clean Record Law (Ficha Limpa) could directly affect the 2026 elections.

item.title: Aliados de Renan Santos e Caiado veem oportunidade em debate sem Lula
item.description: Allies of Renan Santos (Mission) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) see an opportunity in Lula’s likely absence from the Band’s first presidential debate on August 23, as the PT leader may focus on the runoff. They plan to target Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), viewed as the only rival bold enough to challenge Lula, while Caiado and Zema (Novo) would avoid attacking Flávio due to voter backlash from their past Bolsonarist ties.

item.title: Javier Milei faz novos ataques a Lula e o chama de 'ladrão' e 'corrupto'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei again criticized Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him a 'thief' and 'corrupt' in an interview with La Nación. The remarks were made on Sunday (2) and highlight ongoing tensions between the two leaders.

item.title: Flávio chega à reta final das convenções sem vice e com desafio de aparar arestas com aliados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), the main opposition figure in Brazil's 2026 presidential race, is struggling to select a running mate and build alliances as party conventions deadline approaches on Wednesday. He has approached figures such as Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), Daniella Marques (Republicanos), Renata Abreu (Podemos), and Marina Candia (PSDB), but their parties lean toward neutrality. The PL is considering internal options like Júlia Zanatta (SC) and Priscila Costa (CE) but prefers to attract external support.

item.title: Brasil versus Argentina e Paraguai: a América do Sul em tempos de polarização - O Assunto #1774
item.description: Brazil is facing a diplomatic crisis with Argentina and Paraguay after Argentine President Javier Milei called Lula a 'prisoner' and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash' during a PL party convention, and after Lula claimed Paraguay 'invaded' Brazil, referencing the Paraguayan War. Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, was recalled to Brasília for three meetings with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, signaling the severity of the rupture. The episode reflects growing ideological polarization in the region, with Milei and allied leaders promoting a liberal-conservative agenda contrasting with Lula's government, threatening Mercosul's stability.

item.title: Comprador da Naskar deixou o país com mandado de prisão em aberto
item.description: Douglas Silva de Oliveira Azara, accused of masterminding the Naskar fraud that diverted R$60 million from Zema Financeira, fled to Dubai on July 15 after a preventive arrest warrant was issued on July 1. Despite claiming the trip was for vacation or business, he is under investigation for orchestrating a scheme that defrauded over 3,000 clients of R$900 million and now flaunts a luxurious lifestyle on social media, including luxury cars and poker games.

item.title: O discurso que Lula não fará
item.description: Lula rejects the notion that Trump could 'overpower' Brazil, stating his government views tariff increases as an opportunity for economic modernization. He stresses that decisions are guided by national interest, not electoral calculations, and frames external pressure as a failure on the other side’s part.

item.title: STF retoma trabalhos nesta segunda com pauta polêmica e expectativa sobre Código de Ética
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumes activities after the July recess with a controversial agenda, including rulings on coup-related actions, the Maria da Penha Law applied to non-familial aggressors, nepotism in political offices, mining in indigenous lands, regulation of digital platforms, and the employment status of app-based drivers. There is expectation for progress on a Judicial Ethics Code for ministers, though deep discussion is expected post-October elections. Additional pending matters include the Dosimetry Law, which could benefit Jair Bolsonaro, and amendments to the Clean Record Law affecting eligibility for office.

item.title: Recuo do recuo: Republicanos se reúne para reavaliar veto a candidatura de Cleitinho em Minas
item.description: The Republicans party is reconsidering its veto on Senator Cleitinho Azevedo’s candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais after threats from party-aligned federal and state deputy candidates to withdraw if he does not run. A meeting on Monday between Cleitinho and national party president Marcos Pereira will decide whether he will be nominated, despite prior support for Marcelo Aro (PP). Cleitinho signaled his resolve via social media, invoking a biblical metaphor of overcoming adversity.

item.title: Milei nega ter sido agressivo em evento do PL e faz novos ataques a Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei renewed his attacks on Lula, calling him a 'thief' and 'corrupt', and dismissed Brazilian criticism of his speech at the PL convention where he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro. He defended his remarks as spontaneous and argued that calling a thief a thief is far less serious than theft itself. The Argentine Municipal Federation apologized to Brazil, stating Milei's comments were an unacceptable lack of respect.

item.title: Milei retoma ataques a Lula e eleva tensão entre Argentina e Brasil
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei renewed attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him a 'thief' and 'corrupt' in an interview with local broadcaster LN+, following the annulment of Lula's convictions in Operation Car Wash. Milei defended his previous remarks, dismissed criticism from the Brazilian government, and praised Flávio Bolsonaro as an ally to 'stop socialism', escalating diplomatic tensions between Argentina and Brazil. The Brazilian Foreign Ministry summoned Argentina's ambassador for clarification, calling unprecedented the statements by a foreign head of state against Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Nikolas posta paródia do jingle de Lula: “Ele é um bandido”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) posted a parody of President Lula's campaign jingle, accusing him of being a bandit who moved from the hinterlands to São Paulo to steal and made history to make Brazilians cry. The parody changes the original chorus to claim Lula is a bandit who will rob your family, using the same beat as MC Bob Rum's 'Rap do Silva'. Lula's original jingle portrays him as a worker, defender of the poor, and creator of social programs, while Ferreira's version associates him with corruption and theft.

item.title: Programa de Lula deve reforçar compromisso com arcabouço fiscal
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government program, to be released this month, will reinforce the administration's commitment to fiscal austerity and the fiscal framework. The initiative aims to convey credibility to markets and ensure public account sustainability amid pressure for increased social spending. The measure is part of the government's strategy to balance growth with fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Filtro de processos inspirado no STF promete desafogar STJ e preocupa advogados
item.description: The Superior Court of Justice (STJ) awaits presidential sanction to implement a relevance filter inspired by the STF's general repercussion mechanism, establishing criteria for admitting special appeals and giving binding effect to its rulings on lower courts. The measure aims to alleviate case overload but raises concerns among lawyers about potential restrictions on access to justice.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai aceitar resultado das urnas e que TSE é diferente de 2022
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential candidate for the PL, stated that he will accept the election results in 2026 and believes the TSE will be different from 2022. The remark was made on Sunday, February 2, 2026, amid ongoing debates about electoral legitimacy.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Flávio na convenção do PL em Brasília
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro spoke at the PL convention in Brasília, launching his 2026 presidential candidacy. He emphasized proposals for daycare centers, technical education with post-employment financing, lowering the age of criminal responsibility, and chemical castration for rapists, while highlighting support from his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro and the northeastern electorate in the Federal District.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete dobrar orçamento da segurança pública em 1º ano de governo, se eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, promised to double the public security budget in his first year in office if elected, stating it will be a priority. The statement was made in an interview on Bandeirantes' Canal Livre program.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em regra fiscal para cortar gastos quando dívida/PIB atingir certo nível
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate for the Liberal Party (PL), advocated for a fiscal rule with a trigger to cut spending when the public debt-to-GDP ratio reaches a certain level. The proposal aims to contain debt growth through automatic adjustments in public spending. He stated the measure would be part of a fiscal responsibility package to ensure the sustainability of public accounts.

item.title: Plano de governo de ACM Neto tem 56,7% de probabilidade de uso de IA, diz perícia
item.description: A forensic analysis by intellectual property specialist Caroline Nunes concluded that ACM Neto's government plan for the 2026 Bahia gubernatorial race has a 56.7% probability of having been produced using artificial intelligence. The assessment was conducted on the document submitted by the former mayor of Salvador, running under the União Brasil party. The findings raise concerns about authorship and originality in political proposals.

item.title: Ex-primeira-dama Michelle Bolsonaro será candidata ao Senado
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro was announced as a Senate candidate on Sunday (2), following weeks of speculation. Her candidacy emerges amid tensions with her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL-RJ presidential candidate, signaling internal divisions within the Bolsonaro clan.
